name: Orendil's Cure
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child.  Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.

To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
narrative.objectives: Bring Orendil's Cure to Pelturas Whitemoon in Astranaar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is from Orendil?

His skill with herbs and healing is great.  This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
narrative.requestItemsText: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
